title: Download scoped designed customer order evidence pages as PDF
description: A user downloads the current customer-shipment report design as Chinese PDF preserving approved-order evidence semantics. Add PDF endpoint to the existing dynamic controller and a narrow Infrastructure exporter using existing PDFsharp/SimHeiPdfFontResolver. Independently validate current fields/dates/page and reauthorize identity/menu/fresh scope via the same server-derived preview, without requiring prior preview. Preserve selected column order, exact-unit quantity evidence, separate original currencies, explicit unknown cells and date/page/source-cap/approved-order context even when columns are deselected; paginate rows/wide columns, show explicit empty evidence, never sum currencies/units or claim actual shipments/receipts. Missing font/render failure returns clear error with no corrupt file. Designer sends current request values and preserves state on errors; detail Excel remains compatible. Development only: reuse existing customer-shipment menu, current-user SalespersonDataScopeService and existing OperationLogMiddleware HTTP audit; remain read-only. Preserve the verified existing sales-order source and identify it as approved-order evidence, never actual shipment or receipt evidence. No client identity/scope/rows/aggregates as authority, permission expansion, arbitrary/model-generated SQL, direct table/business writes, new domain entities or persistence schema, schema/view/stored-procedure changes, migrations, production SQL or real database execution, secrets/.env/config changes, irreversible operations, production deployment or real browser acceptance. Preserve unrelated work. Run focused in-memory service/API/export/UI source-contract tests plus configured safe Release build/test. Any unavailable external environment acceptance must be explicitly environment-blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: PDF independently validates current request and rechecks identity/customer-shipment menu/current scope via the existing preview, rejecting invalid/revoked/cap-overflow requests without a file.

Infrastructure PDF preserves selected columns and row/column pagination with separate currency/unit and explicit unknown evidence plus current-page/date/source-cap/approved-order context, empty evidence and explicit font/render failure.
Designer sends current fields/date/page and surfaces download failures without losing state; PDF/UI and Excel compatibility tests plus safe Release build/test pass.
